notes.title: Hotfix V0.5.12 (Sad Glossy Hammer)
notes.content: [p]Thanks to your continued feedback and sharp insights, we’ve got another round of fixes and improvements hot off the shelf. From livelier storefronts to smarter tutorials and smoother customer queues, we’re fine-tuning the experience to keep your hustle as seamless as possible.[/p][p]Whether you’re chasing profits, dodging shady deals, or just trying to catch a good night’s sleep—we’ve got your back.[/p][p]As always, if you spot anything funky or have fresh ideas, swing by our [b]Discord[/b] or drop a line on the [b]Community Hub[/b]. Let’s keep building this thing together.[/p][p][/p][p]🧾 Keep the shelves stocked and the customers talking — The Dev Team 💼[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc " style="button"]Join Our Discord Channel[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p][b]Idle Animations for Examination Points[/b][/p][p]We added subtle idle animations to item examination points to help catch your eye when they’re explored.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bigger Customer Queue[/b][/p][p]Now, up to four customers can line up at the counter, and sellers won't stop buyers from getting in line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Security and Sleeping Tutorials[/b][/p][p]The security tutorial now begins on the first night, rather than when the store closes for the first time. The sleeping tutorial begins right after the security tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Panel Reminder Animation[/b][/p][p]Added a gentle nudge to the tutorial panel to prevent players from missing key moments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control Hints for Money[/b][/p][p]The money customers hand over now displays same controls hints that the customer displays.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exhibition Showcase Interaction Bug[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue that would block interaction with the exhibition display.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: We added subtle idle animations to item examination points to help catch your eye when they’re explored.
Now, up to four customers can line up at the counter, and sellers won't stop buyers from getting in line.
The security tutorial now begins on the first night, rather than when the store closes for the first time. The sleeping tutorial begins right after the security tutorial.
Added a gentle nudge to the tutorial panel to prevent players from missing key moments.
The money customers hand over now displays same controls hints that the customer displays.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that would block interaction with the exhibition display.

notes.title: Hotfix V0.5.11 (Sad Matte Hammer)
notes.content:
[p]Business never sleeps—and neither do we! Since the demo launched, you've been incredible: bringing in your thoughts, feedback, and sharp eyes from all corners of the community. Thanks to your hustle, we've been digging through the clutter, fixing what’s broken, and polishing up the shelves.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/4d0fb26beb367cf88cde47ff00702009346b1153.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/c78866bd7cfa5a521c39e2411a6de7ceb93d3034.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/5501dd6a607a980043ee79f9419a042365cf28fe.png"][/img][/carousel][p]We’re still digging through the attic of bugs and shiny feature ideas. If something feels off, [i]don’t be shy[/i]—drop by our [b]Discord[/b] or leave a note on the [b]Community Hub[/b]. Your input keeps our shelves stocked and the experience top-notch.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc " style="button"]Join Our Discord Channel[/url][/p][p]🧾 Keep hustling, keep haggling— [b]The Dev Team[/b] 💼[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p][b]Version Names Added:[/b]
Each update now has a name (like [i]Sad Matte Hammer[/i]) for easier tracking. You can find it in the bottom-right corner of the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Language Start-Up Bug Fixed:[/b]
The game no longer starts in unsupported languages. More language options will be added in the future.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NumPad Pricing Support:[/b]
You can now use the NumPad to enter prices. Press NumPad Enter to confirm pricing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pricing Caret:
[/b]For quality of life, we added a caret to the pricing interface.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Brand Label Visibility:[/b]
Brand visuals have been redesigned to make the text more readable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization and Spelling Fixes:[/b]
Several translation, formatting, and spelling issues have been corrected.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
